system.description: You can Dash, as a reaction on your turn, or by spending your reaction in response to a hostile creature moving away from you, you can move up to your movement speed closer to them. When you Dash, you can spend 2 Pressure to make your movement immune to attack of opportunities. In addition, once per turn, creatures of your choice that you pass by within 5 feet of you as part of your Dashes movement, must make a Strength saving throw, being Dazed, and knocked Prone on a failure.
